scripts.check: npm test && npm run check:content && npm run typecheck
scripts.build:android:local: npm run check && PLATFORM=android node scripts/check-release.mjs && mkdir -p artifacts && npx --yes eas-cli@latest build --platform android --profile release --local --output artifacts/bible-memorize.apk
scripts.build:ios:local: npm run check && PLATFORM=ios node scripts/check-release.mjs && mkdir -p artifacts && npx --yes eas-cli@latest build --platform ios --profile release --local --output artifacts/bible-memorize.ipa
